activities_meeting_times.name: activities_meeting_times
activities_meeting_times.value: "activities"."type" <> 'meeting' OR ("activities"."start_at" IS NOT NULL AND "activities"."end_at" IS NOT NULL AND "activities"."end_at" >= "activities"."start_at")

activities_call_fields.name: activities_call_fields
activities_call_fields.value: "activities"."type" <> 'call' OR ("activities"."call_type" IS NOT NULL AND "activities"."call_start_at" IS NOT NULL AND "activities"."call_duration_seconds" IS NOT NULL)

quote_lines_discount.name: quote_lines_discount
quote_lines_discount.value: "quote_lines"."discount_value" IS NULL OR ("quote_lines"."discount_value" >= 0 AND ("quote_lines"."discount_type" IS DISTINCT FROM 'percent' OR "quote_lines"."discount_value" <= 100))

quotes_scale_ok.name: quotes_scale_ok
quotes_scale_ok.value: round("quotes"."sub_total", "quotes"."currency_scale") = "quotes"."sub_total" AND round("quotes"."vat_total", "quotes"."currency_scale") = "quotes"."vat_total" AND round("quotes"."adjustment", "quotes"."currency_scale") = "quotes"."adjustment" AND round("quotes"."grand_total", "quotes"."currency_scale") = "quotes"."grand_total"

sales_order_lines_discount.name: sales_order_lines_discount
sales_order_lines_discount.value: "sales_order_lines"."discount_value" IS NULL OR ("sales_order_lines"."discount_value" >= 0 AND ("sales_order_lines"."discount_type" IS DISTINCT FROM 'percent' OR "sales_order_lines"."discount_value" <= 100))

sales_orders_scale_ok.name: sales_orders_scale_ok
sales_orders_scale_ok.value: round("sales_orders"."sub_total", "sales_orders"."currency_scale") = "sales_orders"."sub_total" AND round("sales_orders"."vat_total", "sales_orders"."currency_scale") = "sales_orders"."vat_total" AND round("sales_orders"."adjustment", "sales_orders"."currency_scale") = "sales_orders"."adjustment" AND round("sales_orders"."grand_total", "sales_orders"."currency_scale") = "sales_orders"."grand_total"
